compile_entries: fn require_rpc_handlers_handle_rpc<H>(handlers: &mut flowersec::RpcHandlers, type_id: u32, handler: H) -> Result<(), flowersec::HandlerRegistrationError> where H: flowersec::RpcHandler { handlers.handle_rpc(type_id, handler) }

fn require_rpc_handlers_handle_notification<H>(handlers: &mut flowersec::RpcHandlers, type_id: u32, handler: H) -> Result<(), flowersec::HandlerRegistrationError> where H: flowersec::NotificationHandler { handlers.handle_notification(type_id, handler) }

fn require_session_handlers_handle_rpc<H>(handlers: &mut flowersec::SessionHandlers, type_id: u32, handler: H) -> Result<(), flowersec::HandlerRegistrationError> where H: flowersec::RpcHandler { handlers.handle_rpc(type_id, handler) }

fn require_session_handlers_handle_stream<K, H>(handlers: &mut flowersec::SessionHandlers, kind: K, handler: H) -> Result<(), flowersec::HandlerRegistrationError> where K: Into<String>, H: flowersec::StreamHandler { handlers.handle_stream(kind, handler) }
